programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James continues his travels in Burgundy, a region famous for its wines and mustard fields - retracing Keith Floyd's visit 30 years ago, James stops at the same vineyard for a personal tour. After sampling some wine made in the year that Keith was here, James cooks in the grounds of the vineyard using the region's best produce to make veal with mustard sauce - he then visits the region's capital of Dijon and tours a factory which gives his granny's gingerbread a run for its money before turning his hand to making some of the city's more famous export of mustard. James then returns to the vineyard to cook chicken livers and chanterelles on toast - in the comfort of his own kitchen, James also makes a delicious beef bourguignon and a classic coq au vin.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: On the rugged shores of Ballintoy, famed as the Iron Islands in Game of Thrones, Dermot journeys into the Atlantic with local fisherman Gordy, in search of the thrill of the catch along one of Ireland's most dramatic coastlines. Back ashore, Gordy and Dermot transport Dermot back to his childhood, cooking up their catch. Dermot travels to Bushmills, and steps into the kitchen of acclaimed restaurant Tartine. Joining chef Gary Stewart, Dermot cooks up a local favourite dessert: whiskey-infused rhubarb and custard. In search of more fine Irish whiskey, Dermot visits the Giant's Causeway, where, perched on ancient stones above crashing waves, he joins a legendary storyteller and whiskey expert for an unforgettable experience.

programme.desc: On the rugged shores of Ballintoy, famed as the Iron Islands in Game of Thrones, Dermot journeys into the Atlantic with local fisherman Gordy, in search of the thrill of the catch along one of Ireland's most dramatic coastlines. Back ashore, Gordy and Dermot transport Dermot back to his childhood, cooking up their catch. Dermot travels to Bushmills, and steps into the kitchen of acclaimed restaurant Tartine. Joining chef Gary Stewart, Dermot cooks up a local favourite dessert: whiskey-infused rhubarb and custard. In search of more fine Irish whiskey, Dermot visits the Giant's Causeway, where, perched on ancient stones above crashing waves, he joins a legendary storyteller and whiskey expert for an unforgettable experience.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary's culinary adventure takes him west to Ballycastle, a former Viking settlement and a jewel of the Causeway Coastal Route. With Rathlin Island on the horizon, Dermot heads out on a wildlife-watching trip, spotting seabirds and seals while uncovering the area's rich history. Back on shore and hungry from the sea air, he joins bakers Ciara and Dara at Ursa Minor, where they bake a blueberry pie using local fruit and a clever twist - infusing pastry with vanilla-tasting fig leaves, as the real thing won't grow on the island. Dessert comes first before Dermot heads inland to Broughgammon Farm. Here, husband-and-wife team Charlie and Becky are reshaping local food culture, championing goat meat and rose veal while giving value to male animals from the dairy industry. Dermot meets the animals and learns to cook the couple's favourite dish: schnitzel.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James continues his travels in Burgundy, a region famous for its wines and mustard fields - retracing Keith Floyd's visit 30 years ago, James stops at the same vineyard for a personal tour. After sampling some wine made in the year that Keith was here, James cooks in the grounds of the vineyard using the region's best produce to make veal with mustard sauce - he then visits the region's capital of Dijon and tours a factory which gives his granny's gingerbread a run for its money before turning his hand to making some of the city's more famous export of mustard. James then returns to the vineyard to cook chicken livers and chanterelles on toast - in the comfort of his own kitchen, James also makes a delicious beef bourguignon and a classic coq au vin.

With Rathlin Island on the horizon, Dermot heads out on a wildlife-watching trip, spotting seabirds and seals while uncovering the area's rich history. Back on shore and hungry from the sea air, he joins bakers Ciara and Dara at Ursa Minor, where they bake a blueberry pie using local fruit and a clever twist - infusing pastry with vanilla-tasting fig leaves, as the real thing won't grow on the island. Dessert comes first before Dermot heads inland to Broughgammon Farm. Here, husband-and-wife team Charlie and Becky are reshaping local food culture, championing goat meat and rose veal while giving value to male animals from the dairy industry. Dermot meets the animals and learns to cook the couple's favourite dish: schnitzel.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James continues his travels in Burgundy, a region famous for its wines and mustard fields - retracing Keith Floyd's visit 30 years ago, James stops at the same vineyard for a personal tour. After sampling some wine made in the year that Keith was here, James cooks in the grounds of the vineyard using the region's best produce to make veal with mustard sauce - he then visits the region's capital of Dijon and tours a factory which gives his granny's gingerbread a run for its money before turning his hand to making some of the city's more famous export of mustard. James then returns to the vineyard to cook chicken livers and chanterelles on toast - in the comfort of his own kitchen, James also makes a delicious beef bourguignon and a classic coq au vin.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: On the rugged shores of Ballintoy, famed as the Iron Islands in Game of Thrones, Dermot journeys into the Atlantic with local fisherman Gordy, in search of the thrill of the catch along one of Ireland's most dramatic coastlines. Back ashore, Gordy and Dermot transport Dermot back to his childhood, cooking up their catch. Dermot travels to Bushmills, and steps into the kitchen of acclaimed restaurant Tartine. Joining chef Gary Stewart, Dermot cooks up a local favourite dessert: whiskey-infused rhubarb and custard. In search of more fine Irish whiskey, Dermot visits the Giant's Causeway, where, perched on ancient stones above crashing waves, he joins a legendary storyteller and whiskey expert for an unforgettable experience.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Romantic musical comedy. An independent single mother who owns a small hotel on the idyllic Greek isle of Kalokairi, Donna is about to let go of Sophie, the spirited daughter she's raised alone. Donna has invited her two life-long best girlfriends - practical, no-nonsense Rosie and wealthy multi-divorcee Tanya - from her one-time backing band Donna and the Dynamos for Sophie's wedding... and Sophie has secretly invited three guests of her own in a quest to find the identity of her father. To walk her down the aisle, Sophie brings back three men from Donna's past to the Mediterranean paradise that they visited 20 years earlier - new love will bloom and old romances will rekindle over 24 hours on a lush island full of possibilities... and the whole story is told through the music of ABBA.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Romantic musical comedy. An independent single mother who owns a small hotel on the idyllic Greek isle of Kalokairi, Donna is about to let go of Sophie, the spirited daughter she's raised alone. Donna has invited her two life-long best girlfriends - practical, no-nonsense Rosie and wealthy multi-divorcee Tanya - from her one-time backing band Donna and the Dynamos for Sophie's wedding... and Sophie has secretly invited three guests of her own in a quest to find the identity of her father. To walk her down the aisle, Sophie brings back three men from Donna's past to the Mediterranean paradise that they visited 20 years earlier - new love will bloom and old romances will rekindle over 24 hours on a lush island full of possibilities... and the whole story is told through the music of ABBA.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary's culinary adventure takes him west to Ballycastle, a former Viking settlement and a jewel of the Causeway Coastal Route. With Rathlin Island on the horizon, Dermot heads out on a wildlife-watching trip, spotting seabirds and seals while uncovering the area's rich history. Back on shore and hungry from the sea air, he joins bakers Ciara and Dara at Ursa Minor, where they bake a blueberry pie using local fruit and a clever twist - infusing pastry with vanilla-tasting fig leaves, as the real thing won't grow on the island. Dessert comes first before Dermot heads inland to Broughgammon Farm. Here, husband-and-wife team Charlie and Becky are reshaping local food culture, championing goat meat and rose veal while giving value to male animals from the dairy industry. Dermot meets the animals and learns to cook the couple's favourite dish: schnitzel.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James continues his travels in Burgundy, a region famous for its wines and mustard fields - retracing Keith Floyd's visit 30 years ago, James stops at the same vineyard for a personal tour. After sampling some wine made in the year that Keith was here, James cooks in the grounds of the vineyard using the region's best produce to make veal with mustard sauce - he then visits the region's capital of Dijon and tours a factory which gives his granny's gingerbread a run for its money before turning his hand to making some of the city's more famous export of mustard. James then returns to the vineyard to cook chicken livers and chanterelles on toast - in the comfort of his own kitchen, James also makes a delicious beef bourguignon and a classic coq au vin.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Romantic musical comedy. An independent single mother who owns a small hotel on the idyllic Greek isle of Kalokairi, Donna is about to let go of Sophie, the spirited daughter she's raised alone. Donna has invited her two life-long best girlfriends - practical, no-nonsense Rosie and wealthy multi-divorcee Tanya - from her one-time backing band Donna and the Dynamos for Sophie's wedding... and Sophie has secretly invited three guests of her own in a quest to find the identity of her father. To walk her down the aisle, Sophie brings back three men from Donna's past to the Mediterranean paradise that they visited 20 years earlier - new love will bloom and old romances will rekindle over 24 hours on a lush island full of possibilities... and the whole story is told through the music of ABBA.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary's culinary adventure takes him west to Ballycastle, a former Viking settlement and a jewel of the Causeway Coastal Route. With Rathlin Island on the horizon, Dermot heads out on a wildlife-watching trip, spotting seabirds and seals while uncovering the area's rich history. Back on shore and hungry from the sea air, he joins bakers Ciara and Dara at Ursa Minor, where they bake a blueberry pie using local fruit and a clever twist - infusing pastry with vanilla-tasting fig leaves, as the real thing won't grow on the island. Dessert comes first before Dermot heads inland to Broughgammon Farm. Here, husband-and-wife team Charlie and Becky are reshaping local food culture, championing goat meat and rose veal while giving value to male animals from the dairy industry. Dermot meets the animals and learns to cook the couple's favourite dish: schnitzel.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James continues his travels in Burgundy, a region famous for its wines and mustard fields - retracing Keith Floyd's visit 30 years ago, James stops at the same vineyard for a personal tour. After sampling some wine made in the year that Keith was here, James cooks in the grounds of the vineyard using the region's best produce to make veal with mustard sauce - he then visits the region's capital of Dijon and tours a factory which gives his granny's gingerbread a run for its money before turning his hand to making some of the city's more famous export of mustard. James then returns to the vineyard to cook chicken livers and chanterelles on toast - in the comfort of his own kitchen, James also makes a delicious beef bourguignon and a classic coq au vin.

programme.desc: On the rugged shores of Ballintoy, famed as the Iron Islands in Game of Thrones, Dermot journeys into the Atlantic with local fisherman Gordy, in search of the thrill of the catch along one of Ireland's most dramatic coastlines. In search of more fine Irish whiskey, Dermot visits the Giant's Causeway, where, perched on ancient stones above crashing waves, he joins a legendary storyteller and whiskey expert for an unforgettable experience.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary's culinary adventure takes him west to Ballycastle, a former Viking settlement and a jewel of the Causeway Coastal Route. With Rathlin Island on the horizon, Dermot heads out on a wildlife-watching trip, spotting seabirds and seals while uncovering the area's rich history. Back on shore and hungry from the sea air, he joins bakers Ciara and Dara at Ursa Minor, where they bake a blueberry pie using local fruit and a clever twist - infusing pastry with vanilla-tasting fig leaves, as the real thing won't grow on the island. Dessert comes first before Dermot heads inland to Broughgammon Farm. Here, husband-and-wife team Charlie and Becky are reshaping local food culture, championing goat meat and rose veal while giving value to male animals from the dairy industry. Dermot meets the animals and learns to cook the couple's favourite dish: schnitzel.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James continues his travels in Burgundy, a region famous for its wines and mustard fields - retracing Keith Floyd's visit 30 years ago, James stops at the same vineyard for a personal tour. After sampling some wine made in the year that Keith was here, James cooks in the grounds of the vineyard using the region's best produce to make veal with mustard sauce - he then visits the region's capital of Dijon and tours a factory which gives his granny's gingerbread a run for its money before turning his hand to making some of the city's more famous export of mustard. James then returns to the vineyard to cook chicken livers and chanterelles on toast - in the comfort of his own kitchen, James also makes a delicious beef bourguignon and a classic coq au vin.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Romantic musical comedy. An independent single mother who owns a small hotel on the idyllic Greek isle of Kalokairi, Donna is about to let go of Sophie, the spirited daughter she's raised alone. Donna has invited her two life-long best girlfriends - practical, no-nonsense Rosie and wealthy multi-divorcee Tanya - from her one-time backing band Donna and the Dynamos for Sophie's wedding... and Sophie has secretly invited three guests of her own in a quest to find the identity of her father. To walk her down the aisle, Sophie brings back three men from Donna's past to the Mediterranean paradise that they visited 20 years earlier - new love will bloom and old romances will rekindle over 24 hours on a lush island full of possibilities... and the whole story is told through the music of ABBA.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Romantic musical comedy. An independent single mother who owns a small hotel on the idyllic Greek isle of Kalokairi, Donna is about to let go of Sophie, the spirited daughter she's raised alone. Donna has invited her two life-long best girlfriends - practical, no-nonsense Rosie and wealthy multi-divorcee Tanya - from her one-time backing band Donna and the Dynamos for Sophie's wedding... and Sophie has secretly invited three guests of her own in a quest to find the identity of her father. To walk her down the aisle, Sophie brings back three men from Donna's past to the Mediterranean paradise that they visited 20 years earlier - new love will bloom and old romances will rekindle over 24 hours on a lush island full of possibilities... and the whole story is told through the music of ABBA.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Romantic musical comedy. An independent single mother who owns a small hotel on the idyllic Greek isle of Kalokairi, Donna is about to let go of Sophie, the spirited daughter she's raised alone. Donna has invited her two life-long best girlfriends - practical, no-nonsense Rosie and wealthy multi-divorcee Tanya - from her one-time backing band Donna and the Dynamos for Sophie's wedding... and Sophie has secretly invited three guests of her own in a quest to find the identity of her father. To walk her down the aisle, Sophie brings back three men from Donna's past to the Mediterranean paradise that they visited 20 years earlier - new love will bloom and old romances will rekindle over 24 hours on a lush island full of possibilities... and the whole story is told through the music of ABBA.

Back on shore and hungry from the sea air, he joins bakers Ciara and Dara at Ursa Minor, where they bake a blueberry pie using local fruit and a clever twist - infusing pastry with vanilla-tasting fig leaves, as the real thing won't grow on the island. Dessert comes first before Dermot heads inland to Broughgammon Farm. Here, husband-and-wife team Charlie and Becky are reshaping local food culture, championing goat meat and rose veal while giving value to male animals from the dairy industry. Dermot meets the animals and learns to cook the couple's favourite dish: schnitzel.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James continues his travels in Burgundy, a region famous for its wines and mustard fields - retracing Keith Floyd's visit 30 years ago, James stops at the same vineyard for a personal tour. After sampling some wine made in the year that Keith was here, James cooks in the grounds of the vineyard using the region's best produce to make veal with mustard sauce - he then visits the region's capital of Dijon and tours a factory which gives his granny's gingerbread a run for its money before turning his hand to making some of the city's more famous export of mustard. James then returns to the vineyard to cook chicken livers and chanterelles on toast - in the comfort of his own kitchen, James also makes a delicious beef bourguignon and a classic coq au vin.

Harriet's boyfriend Finn Robson has been missing since the couple tried to run away together a year before. When Edward Stannington - the president of the local chess society - is found dead in a lake with an ice pick in his back, his damaged car is nearby and Kate finds a clue in his mouth, a chess notation known as the Sicilian Defence. Could the attack which left Harriet for dead a year ago be linked to moves on a chess board, and where is her boyfriend Finn?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a woman is crushed to death by a giant round of cheese at the home of the world-famous Midsomer Blue, Barnaby and Jones are soon on the case. Debbie Moffett worked at the dairy, founded by her colleague Jim Caxton, who seems more anxious about his precious cheese than Debbie's death. Later, Debbie's lover Oliver Ordish is garrotted with cheese wire and covered with cheese fly larvae. Jones then discovers that dairy owner Gregory Brantner was paying the dead man a consultancy fee. That night Gregory goes to investigate an alarm at the dairy and is stabbed through the heart with a cheese needle. Can Barnaby and Jones stop the killer before the bitterness of the past leads to yet more agonising deaths?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Nelson investigate a series of murders in Midsomer St Claire that seem to be inspired by macabre images on a medieval fresco recently discovered in the church crypt - as the village prepares for storms and flooding, it appears that someone is using ancient torture methods to punish modern-day sinners. Who is responsible and what motive do they have?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Crime drama series based on characters created by Ann Cleeves. DCI Vera Stanhope is called to a quiet country lane where a young man has been found dead following a collision with a car - on closer inspection, it becomes clear that this is not an accident and is way more than a hit-and-run. Vera discovers that our victim is a popular market trader and heads down to his pitch to start to put together an idea of who our man is and ascertain why anyone would want him dead - as the investigation gathers pace, Vera learns that our cheeky chappy was a complex character who was antagonistic, arrogant and able to get what he wants, but it also appears that all of this came at a price. As she unravels secrets, lies, betrayal, fractious relationships and intense rivalries, Vera must work out who would want the barrow boy buried - meanwhile, a familiar face from the past turns up with an uncertain agenda.

programme.desc: 1950. Action. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Don Stannard, Tamara Desni & George Ford. Dick Barton is assigned to find a kidnapped professor and deactivate a death ray before catastrophe occurs. [S]

programme.title: Runaround
programme.desc: 1979. Presented by Mike Reid with Bill Gamon for prizes and contestants. Prizes: Beach Head Assault game, a telescope, a calculator, a cassette recorder and the star prize is a TV set.

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Dean and the Princess are married and celebrations are had. Corruption still remains within the palace and a surprise guest appears...

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Bridge. 1957. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. A plot is uncovered towards the Poltifax villagers by Squire Brian as he prepares for his knighthood. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: How to Hatch a Dinosaur. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Vincent Price. Egghead & Olga attempt to hatch an ancient Neosaurus egg and feed the baby dinosaur a meal of Batman, Robin and Batgirl. [S]

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Franklin Story. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Stan Francis. After several people are murdered Hawkeye seeks the help of his friend Benjamin Franklin. [S]

programme.title: Captain Scarlet and the Mysterons
programme.desc: Lunarville 7. 1967. Stars Cy Grant, Ed Bishop & David Healy. When the Lunar Controller claims he can negotiate peace between the Moon and the Mysterons, the team are sent out to investigate. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Avenger. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Tell investigates why two envoys disappeared when on they're on a way to him to discuss a treaty of friendship. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Conquistador. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Roger Delgado & Laurence Herder. A series of attacks are blamed on Dan Tempest and the crew of the Sultana, but Beamish refuses to believe the rumours. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Goldmaker. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Alfie Bass & Ian Hunter. Robin comes to the aid of Sir Richard of Lea who needs help untangling his finances and to deal with Lepidus the Alchemist. [S]

programme.title: The Lost Continent (1951)
programme.desc: 1951. Sci-fi. Director: Sam Newfield. Stars Cesar Romero, Hillary Brooke & John Hoyt. Major Joe Nolan leads a search for a downed atomic rocket, but the crew crash-land on an island of dinosaurs. [S]

programme.title: Brighton Rock
programme.desc: 1947. Crime. Directed by John Boulting. Stars Richard Attenborough & Hermione Baddeley. Small time gang leader, Pinkie Brown, desperately tries to cover his tracks after he murders a journalist. [S]

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Special Edition. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Richard Bennet & Donald Bisset. A gang of career criminals believe they have the perfect alibi when they carry out a payroll robbery in Fleet Street. [S]

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Canoomba Incident. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Anthony Wickert & Janette Craig. Canoomba is empty of men after a gold strike. Things get strange after Cobb is robbed by a what appears to be a girl. [S]

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: 1959. Horror. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee & Yvonne Furneaux. A mummified priest is awakened by the opening of an Egyptian princess's sarcophagus. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Enjoy this performance of Come Softly to Me by the American vocal group the Delta Rhythm Boys.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1961. Wings of Death. Directed by Allan Davis. Starring Harry H. Corbett, Peter Bowles and Simon Lack. A light aeroplane comes down in Kent, killing the pilot. It was no accident... (S1, E38)

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Log of the Cap Fagnet. 1963. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Helen Shingler. A conspiracy of silence protects the murderer of Captain Fallut. Can Maigret find any significant clues? [S]

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: The Outsiders. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Derek Smith. A modest and kind man is treated like a visiting dignitary when Louisa and Charlie find out the reason for his visit. [S]

programme.title: Turn The Key Softly
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Jack Lee. Stars Yvonne Mitchell, Joan Collins, Kathleen Harrison. Three women are released from Holloway prison on the same morning into the bustle of post-war London. [S]

programme.title: Music Unlimited
programme.desc: 1973. British music show featuring contemporary music acts of the time. Enjoy some rare performances from Heads, Hands and Feet, Julie Felix, Barry Ryan, Mary Hopkin and Lulu.

programme.title: Fortean TV
programme.desc: 1997. Hosted by Reverend Lionel Fanthorpe. Tonight, a woman who can speak to cats, a man who unearthed a maggot growing in his head and a lifeform that some people claim to be an alien.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: Twelve Hours to Live. 1959. Starring Paul Richards, Jean Allison & Douglas Kennedy. A husband drives off after an argument. His wife feels he is in danger and begins to receive telepathic vision. [S]

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1996. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes and Jean Paul Gaultier. Tonight, unveil the Madame Tussaud's waxwork of Jean Paul and meet the gay Take That from Dublin, Four Guyz.

programme.desc: 1963. Crime. Director: Aram Katcher. Stars Aram Katcher, Lisa McDonald & Brad Trumbull. A sleazy but ingenious criminal plans some brutal ruses to elude the law but he is his own worst enemy. [S]
